messages:
Alex: wow team, woke up to analytics showing we doubled typical daily requests overnight 1.9M today. this is huge 389. quick celebration in the kitchen at 10:05 for those in office, zoom link for remote: https://zoom.fake/cheers 
Rachael: yessssss!!! bringing balloons :balloon: and a tiny banner that says '2x momentum'
Sanjeev: infrastructural note: autoscaler added 4 instances during window, 95p latency held. saw some brief 429 spikes around 03:12 but retries cleared. will drop a short post in eng-sre with metrics
Molly: I'll bring a pastry assortment (donuts + croissants) and coffee urn. poll: savory or sweet crowd?
DevRel Jen: I'll draft a candid social post and a customer-facing blurb. can i quote folks on what changed (kv-cache + batching tweaks)?
Ops Bot: ops-bot: Notice logged: spike at 03:10 UTC, autoscale events x4, fallback to warm pool once, no 5xx events.
Alex: quote away, call out batching wins. also small gong moment at 10:07 941 (i will attempt ceremonial gentle gong)
Rachael: remote folks drop a party GIF and i'll compile a slideshare :tada:
Molly: bagels for those who prefer savory, donuts for sugar fans. i'm holding both :)
Sanjeev: will reach out to a couple high-volume clients about backoff hints. otherwise, celebrate and log notes.
DevRel Jen: social draft posted to #marketing in 10, will tag contributors.
Alex: huge thanks all. small win, big signal. next milestone: 5x? cake or a bigger gong? :thinking_face:
